capabilities.target: owner-private Unix domain socket at the VLT-PM48 runtime path
capabilities.justification: Binds the local agent's request socket after verifying its parent directory and reclaiming only a stale, same-user-owned prior socket file.

capabilities.target: owner-private Unix domain socket at the VLT-PM48 runtime path
capabilities.justification: The CLI-side client connects to a running agent to look up, retain, forget, or ask the status of a cached passphrase, and to signal shutdown.

capabilities.target: the agent socket path and its existing metadata
capabilities.justification: Verifies an existing path at the socket location is a socket owned by this same user before ever reclaiming (unlinking) it.
Sets owner-only (0600) permissions on the bound socket file as defense in depth beneath the peer-credential check.
Removes a stale socket left by an unclean prior exit before rebinding, and removes its own socket file on a clean shutdown.

capabilities.target: this same executable, re-executed as the detached agent process
capabilities.justification: `agent start` launches the long-lived agent as a double-forked, session-detached child so it outlives the one-shot command that started it, mirroring vault-pm-cli-host's clipboard clearer.

capabilities.target: this same executable, via the caller-supplied program path
capabilities.justification: The detached child re-executes the running `vault-pm` binary as `agent run-foreground` with a fixed, caller-controlled-free argument vector.

capabilities.target: libc socket peer-credential and process-identity APIs (SO_PEERCRED, getpeereid, getuid, fork, setsid)
capabilities.justification: Verifies the kernel-reported real UID of every connecting peer before serving it, and performs the detached double-fork used by `agent start`. Neither is reachable through portable Rust I/O.

capabilities.target: short fixed poll intervals (accept-loop retry, idle-bound sweep, client readiness poll)
capabilities.justification: Polls a non-blocking listener and a background auto-lock sweep on short fixed intervals, and bounds every client round trip and `agent start` readiness wait so a slow or unreachable agent fails no slower than a missing one.

justification: Permission-checked Unix-domain-socket transport and in-memory passphrase retention for the local vault-pm agent (VLT-PM48). Performs no configuration, provider, or vault-content access, and depends on no cryptographic or application package; it retains and returns only the opaque passphrase bytes a caller already verified elsewhere.
